how-claude-remembers-your-project.notes: Page title and intro: two memory mechanisms — CLAUDE.md (user-written) and auto memory (Claude-written).

each-claude-code-session-begins.notes: States fresh context window per session; two carry-across mechanisms introduced.

claude-md-vs-auto-memory.notes: Comparison table: CLAUDE.md (user-written, instructions/rules, project/user/org scope, loaded every session in full) vs auto memory (Claude-written, learnings/patterns, per working tree, first 200 lines or 25KB). Key scope distinction.

subagents-can-also-maintain.notes: Subagents can maintain their own auto memory; links to subagent configuration.

claude-md-files-intro.notes: CLAUDE.md files are plain-text markdown; read at session start.

when-to-add-to-claude-md.notes: Trigger conditions for adding to CLAUDE.md: repeated mistakes, code review catches, repeated corrections, onboarding-level context. Keep to facts needed every session; multi-step or scoped content goes to skills or rules.

choose-where-to-put-claude-md-files.notes: Four scopes: managed policy (org-wide, not excludable), project instructions (./CLAUDE.md or ./.claude/CLAUDE.md), user instructions (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md), local instructions (CLAUDE.local.md). More specific takes precedence. Files above CWD loaded at launch; subdirectory files load on demand.

set-up-a-project-claude-md.notes: Project CLAUDE.md stored at ./CLAUDE.md or ./.claude/CLAUDE.md. /init auto-generates from codebase analysis. CLAUDE_CODE_NEW_INIT=1 enables interactive multi-phase setup.

write-effective-instructions.notes: Size: target under 200 lines; longer reduces adherence. Structure: markdown headers/bullets. Specificity: concrete, verifiable rules. Consistency: conflicting rules cause arbitrary picks. CLAUDE.md is context not enforced config — compliance not guaranteed.

import-additional-files.notes: @path/to/import syntax expands at launch. Relative paths resolve from the importing file. Max 5 hops recursion. External imports trigger approval dialog on first encounter.

worktrees-import-workaround.notes: CLAUDE.local.md is worktree-local (gitignored). To share personal instructions across worktrees, import from home directory.

agents-md.notes: Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md, not AGENTS.md. Interop: create CLAUDE.md that @imports AGENTS.md, then appends Claude-specific instructions.

how-claude-md-files-load.notes: Load order: walks up directory tree from CWD, concatenates (not overrides). CLAUDE.local.md appended after CLAUDE.md at each level (personal notes last = higher priority). Subdirectory files load on-demand when Claude reads files there.

html-comments-stripped.notes: Block-level HTML comments stripped before injection into context — free maintainer notes. Comments inside code blocks preserved. Read tool shows raw content including comments.

load-from-additional-directories.notes: --add-dir flag by default does NOT load CLAUDE.md from those dirs. Set CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1 to enable. Loads CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules/*.md, CLAUDE.local.md from additional dir.

organize-rules-with-claude-rules.notes: Rules in .claude/rules/ keep instructions modular. Path-scoped rules reduce noise and context usage by only loading when matching files are read. Note distinguishes rules (always-loaded or trigger-loaded) from skills (only when invoked).

set-up-rules.notes: Place .md files in .claude/rules/. One topic per file, descriptive filename. Discovered recursively. Rules without paths: frontmatter load at launch alongside .claude/CLAUDE.md.

path-specific-rules.notes: YAML frontmatter with paths: field scopes rule to matching files. Trigger: when Claude reads a matching file, not on every tool use. Glob patterns supported; brace expansion available. Rules without paths: field are unconditional.

share-rules-across-projects-with-symlink.notes: .claude/rules/ supports symlinks. Circular symlinks detected and handled gracefully.

user-level-rules.notes: ~/.claude/rules/ applies to every project. User-level rules loaded before project rules, so project rules have higher priority.

manage-claude-md-for-large-teams.notes: Section intro for org-wide management features.

deploy-organization-wide-claude-md.notes: Managed policy CLAUDE.md locations: macOS /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/CLAUDE.md, Linux /etc/claude-code/CLAUDE.md, Windows C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\CLAUDE.md. Cannot be excluded by individual settings. Deployed via MDM/Group Policy/Ansible.

managed-vs-settings-table.notes: Clarifies managed CLAUDE.md vs managed settings. Settings = technical enforcement (deny lists, sandbox, env vars, auth). CLAUDE.md = behavioral guidance (code style, compliance reminders). Settings enforced by client; CLAUDE.md is context, not hard enforcement.

exclude-specific-claude-md-files.notes: claudeMdExcludes setting skips files by glob against absolute path. Configurable at user/project/local/managed-policy layers; arrays merge. Managed policy CLAUDE.md cannot be excluded.

auto-memory-section.notes: Auto memory intro: Claude saves notes without user intervention. Build commands, debugging insights, architecture, style, workflow habits. Claude decides what's worth saving — not every session. Requires v2.1.59+.

enable-or-disable-auto-memory.notes: On by default. Toggle via /memory UI or autoMemoryEnabled setting. Disable via CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1 env var.

storage-location.notes: ~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/ per-repo (git-derived path). All worktrees + subdirs of same repo share one directory. Outside git repo: project root used. autoMemoryDirectory setting overrides location (accepted from policy/local/user, NOT project settings to prevent redirect attacks). Machine-local; not shared across machines.

memory-directory-structure.notes: MEMORY.md is the index entrypoint. Topic files (debugging.md, api-conventions.md) hold details. Claude maintains MEMORY.md to track what's where.

how-it-works.notes: First 200 lines or 25KB of MEMORY.md loaded at session start. Beyond threshold: not loaded. Topic files not loaded at startup — read on demand. CLAUDE.md loaded in full regardless of length. Claude shows 'Writing memory' / 'Recalled memory' notifications.

audit-and-edit-your-memory.notes: Auto memory is plain markdown; edit or delete at any time. /memory command to browse.

view-and-edit-with-memory.notes: /memory command lists CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, and rules files in current session. Toggle auto memory. Open auto memory folder. 'Remember X' → auto memory; 'add to CLAUDE.md' → CLAUDE.md.

claude-isnt-following-my-claude-md.notes: CLAUDE.md delivered as user message after system prompt — not enforced config. No guarantee of strict compliance, especially for vague/conflicting instructions. Debug steps: /memory to verify loading, check location, make instructions specific, check for conflicts. For system-prompt-level instructions: --append-system-prompt (automation only). InstructionsLoaded hook for debugging.

i-dont-know-what-auto-memory-saved.notes: /memory + auto memory folder to inspect. All plain markdown.

my-claude-md-is-too-large.notes: Files over 200 lines consume more context and may reduce adherence. Solution: @path imports or .claude/rules/ split.

instructions-seem-lost-after-compact.notes: Project-root CLAUDE.md survives /compact (re-read from disk). Nested CLAUDE.md does not auto-reload — reloads next time matching file is read. Conversation-only instructions lost unless added to CLAUDE.md.

related-resources-memory.notes: Links to skills, settings, subagent memory pages.
